author: A. A. Milne
title: When We Were Very Young
edition: New York: E. P. Dutton; twenty-third printing, March 1925, of the text first published and copyrighted in 1924. The printing table is preserved in the source. Transcription treatment: HTML inline emphasis is represented as plain text; page numbers, image captions, illustrations, and digitizer boilerplate are excluded. Prose line-wrap whitespace is collapsed within each paragraph; verse line breaks and stanza boundaries are retained, with indentation whitespace normalized. Original wording, spelling, and punctuation are retained, including apparent historical or transcription oddities.

rights.basis: The selected English literary text was published in 1925, before 1931, and its maximum 95-year US publication term has expired as of 2026. Project Gutenberg explicitly identifies this ebook as public domain in the USA.

acquisition.method: Downloaded Project Gutenberg HTML pg70271-images.html from the aleph.pglaf.org mirror of the Gutenberg cache and converted with a scratch HTML parser: h1–h6 become headings, p elements paragraphs, stanza divs and br-broken lines stanzas (one line per printed line, indentation dropped), HTML entities decoded, inline emphasis rendered as plain text, prose whitespace folded to single spaces. Omitted throughout: the Project Gutenberg header, footer and licence, page-number anchors, illustrations and their captions, the title page, the copyright and printing table, and the contents with its note on the Queen's Dolls' House. Kept: the dedication, the author's preface "Just Before We Begin" with its signature, and every poem; hidden layout spans (class ns) are dropped, and stanzas split in the HTML only to permit a page break (class stanza00) are rejoined.
